title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: scope just-in-time audit to users and groups
summary: Hold: the summary incorrectly says that only audit-scope users have activity logged, although Microsoft's notice also records activity for block-scope users. The detailed explanation, rollout window and licensing are supported; the controls table needs a fuller audit-setting path.

claims.claim: JIT protection will log activity only for users and groups placed in an audit scope.
claims.quote: Users included in block scope will be prevented from completing actions while files are evaluated for sensitive information. Their activities are recorded in Activity explorer.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's first sentence with 'Endpoint DLP just-in-time protection will require explicit audit scope configuration; block-scope users will also continue to have activity recorded.' In Why it matters, replace 'logged only for users and groups you name' with 'explicitly scoped audit logging, while block-scope activity is also recorded', as stated in MC1387575.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits the briefing's verified rollout timing and medium-risk audit visibility change.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; risk: "medium"; "rollout to mid-December 2026"; "audit logging must be explicitly configured"
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now': on the 19 November 2026 run date, the December rollout is within about 60 days, existing logging behavior changes, and administrators must configure scope to maintain visibility. This meets the schema's act-now definition even without a supplied act-by date.
